==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Acquire 50 pieces of [[Candy Corn]] by participating in [[Halloween]] activities.
* See Gul Terror for your reward. 

===Reward===
* [[Ghoulish Accessory Token]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Gul Terror
:''"I'm not the biggest fan this holiday ever had, you know. I'll be glad when people stop running about scaring the pants off one another. There's plenty out there that's terrifying without the tricksters at play. Real horrors, like [[dryder]]s and [[demon]]s and...[[Dhuum|Dhuuuuum]]. A "harmless" joke can flutter a weak heart as much as a bona fide brush with death!''

:''Anyway, I wouldn't be here if I wasn't ordered to. "You've got to do your part," the sorceress said. "It's your duty to the coven," she said. "Stop hiding under the table," she said, and then she gave me all these holiday accessory tokens.''

:''I'd be happy to give you one, but I need to gather (let me check the note) '''candy corn'''. I know you can get it in those [[Trick-or-Treat Bag|trick-or-treat bags]], but that would involve fighting...[[creature]]s or travelling {{sic|British English "travelling" instead of American English "traveling"}} to [[The Underworld|the...Uuuuunderworld]]. I would never!"''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = Sure! I was going to do that anyway.
|decline = Do I look like the sort of person who shares their candy corn?
|ask = I should be back at my shipyard, not waiting around for someone to frighten me all in the name of "fun!" Hurry back with that '''candy corn''' so I can fill my quota and depart.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Gul Terror
:''"Yes, this candy corn will be perfect for...eating. You can't eat that token though. In fact, I don't think it has much use other than being traded to '''[[Erulis]]''' for Halloween accessories. Not that I understand why anyone would want to look like a zombie or a scarecrow. Twisted!"''

== Notes ==
{{bug|Unlike other [[quest]]s, this quest is not indicated with a ''"(Completed)"'' beside the quest name in the Quest Log after the objective is completed.}}
{{bug|You cannot accept the quest reward while your [[character]]'s [[inventory]] is full and the inventory holds another Ghoulish Accessory Token in it, even though Ghoulish Accessory Tokens are [[Item stacking|stackable]].}}

== Trivia ==
* This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2012]].
